title: HALOZYME REPORTS RECORD SECOND QUARTER 2026 RESULTS, BEATS ESTIMATES AND RAISES FULL YEAR 2026 FINANCIAL GUIDANCE
summary: Halozyme Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: HALO) ("Halozyme" or the "Company") today reported its financial and operating results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, and provided an update on its recent corporate activities. "We delivered another quarter of strong performance, with multiple proof points demonstrating the attractive features of ENHANZE as a compounding platform engine: repeatability of success, scalability, diversification and durability of revenues," said Dr. Helen Torley, President and Chief Executive Officer. "Total revenue increased 48% year-over-year to $481 million, royalty revenue increased 50% to $308 million and adjusted EBITDA grew 46% to $329 million, reflecting the strength of our differentiated royalty business. Based on these record results, we are raising our full year 2026 financial guidance." "Importantly, we are delivering on both our near-term and long-term growth objectives.
